nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config for the client app, ignoring node_modules, dist, and public directories while linting TypeScript and JavaScript source files in src and server.

nodes.name: postcss.config.js
nodes.summary: PostCSS configuration enabling Tailwind CSS processing and autoprefixer for cross-browser CSS compatibility in the client app.

nodes.name: manifest.webmanifest
nodes.summary: Progressive Web App manifest for Cosmos ERP, configuring the app name, start URL at the warehouse mobile view, display mode, theme colors, and icon assets.

nodes.name: sw.js
nodes.summary: Service worker for the Cosmos mobile PWA that handles offline fallback caching for /m/ and /api/ routes, and relays background sync events to window clients for offline queue processing.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Background Sync API to notify clients when connectivity is restored, enabling the offline queue to drain.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Main Express server entry point that serves the Vite React SPA alongside the web API on a single port, bridging HTTP requests to the web app's fetch-based API router and adding security headers.
nodes.languageNotes: Bridges Express (Node.js streams) with the web app's fetch-based Request/Response API model, streaming SSE responses via reader/writer.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Bootstraps the Express server by loading env, dynamically importing the API router and background jobs, wiring up API proxy middleware and Vite dev/static serving, then listening on the configured port.

nodes.name: sendWebResponse
nodes.summary: Converts a fetch API Response object into an Express response, handling streaming bodies and SSE content types.

nodes.name: cosmos-img.tsx
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper React component around the native img element, providing a typed ImgProps interface compatible with Next.js Image API signatures for easy migration.

nodes.name: vite-env.d.ts
nodes.summary: TypeScript ambient type declarations for Vite environment variables used in the client app, including gateway URL, Stripe publishable key, and web admin origin.

nodes.name: tailwind.config.ts
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS configuration defining the Cosmos design system token set including a dark-themed color palette, Inter/JetBrains Mono font stacks, and custom border radius and shadow values.
nodes.languageNotes: The 'cosmos' color object defines all brand tokens used across the UI package and client app.

nodes.name: vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vite build configuration for the React client app, setting up path aliases for @, @cosmos/web-gateway-client, and @cosmos/ui monorepo packages, and configuring port 4000.

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config for the web app, globally ignoring node_modules, generated, .next, dist, and public directories.

nodes.name: background-jobs.ts
nodes.summary: Lightweight in-process background job scheduler that runs an inventory reservation sweep every 10 minutes, started once by the API server at startup.

nodes.name: retrieval.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the Celestial AI RAG retrieval module, verifying document chunk loading, keyword scoring, and plain-language preference across multiple domain queries.

nodes.name: retrieval.ts
nodes.summary: RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) document retrieval engine for the Celestial AI assistant, loading and chunking platform Markdown docs, scoring chunks by keyword and synonym expansion, and returning the most relevant context for a given query.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a custom BM25-style scoring with domain-specific synonym expansion (e.g. 'pos' expands to 'register', 'checkout') and plain-language mode boosting for non-technical responses.

nodes.name: retrievePlatformDocs
nodes.summary: Main exported retrieval function that scores all loaded document chunks against a query and returns the top matching chunks, with fallback to broad-topic matches when scoring yields insufficient results.

nodes.name: formatDocContext
nodes.summary: Formats an array of document chunks into a Markdown-formatted string suitable for injection into an LLM prompt context.

nodes.name: parseMarkdownFile
nodes.summary: Parses a Markdown file into structured DocChunk objects by splitting on H2 and H3 section headings, truncating body text to a maximum chunk size.

nodes.name: cycle-count-adjust.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit tests for cycle count delta and adjustment determination utility functions, covering positive/negative delta and null count edge cases.

nodes.name: cycle-count-adjust.ts
nodes.summary: Pure utility functions for warehouse cycle count reconciliation: computes the inventory delta between system quantity and counted quantity, and determines whether a line needs adjustment.

nodes.name: event-bus.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal event bus stub that publishes domain events to Redis when configured, or falls back to console logging, with a convenience function for order-domain events.
nodes.languageNotes: Stub implementation — the Redis transport path is present but only logs to console; a real Redis client would need to be wired in for production pub/sub.

nodes.name: invoice-document.ts
nodes.summary: Generates printable HTML invoice documents for the AR module, fetching customer name from CRM and rendering line items, credit memos, totals, and print-friendly styling.

nodes.name: buildInvoiceHtml
nodes.summary: Async function that builds a complete HTML invoice document string from invoice input data, resolving the customer name via CRM and escaping all user-provided values to prevent XSS.
